subject.title: fix(dashscope): apply request policy to video requests

question: Should existing Qwen and Alibaba request policy govern DashScope polling and generated-video downloads as well as submission?
rationale: The implementation is correct and improves SSRF safety, but it broadens the effect of existing proxy, TLS, dispatcher, and private-network settings, so the feature owner must accept the upgrade boundary.

options.title: Accept consistent propagation
options.body: Honor the existing request policy for all DashScope stages while retaining guarded defaults and credential isolation for generated URLs.

options.title: Restrict download routing
options.body: Apply policy to provider-origin submission and polling but keep generated-video downloads on default guarded routing without provider dispatcher overrides.

recommendation.title: Accept consistent propagation
recommendation.body: Honor the existing request policy for all DashScope stages while retaining guarded defaults and credential isolation for generated URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person directly to both provider implementations and the shared DashScope ownership boundary.
